content:
As I think was discussed during the workshop by some people; it would be very helpful to finally move everything to the module system (currently "only" FormalConjectures/ remains). I have FC#4688 open, which as of writing is up to date (it is fairly easy to update with AI and the Modulize.lean script).

As discussed, it breaks many native_decide. Often, this can be mitigated / an alternative proof works, but currently the PR adds 27 new sorry's to previously proven API lemmas with native_decide (personally I dont find this a big degression, since one morally should think about how to prove them effectively anyways).

336 open PRs currently add a new file; these need to be adopted. (but the adoption should be very trivial in the vast majority of cases)
With the open PRs you can just check for it in CI and make people update. But what is this native_decide issue?

https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/113488-general/topic/native_decide.20in.20module.20system.20issue/with/614561087

but I dont know enough about Lean's internals to say more about that :)

I would be in favor of merging this with the 27 native_decides changed to sorries, maybe with an inline comment mentioning the sorry was previously dispatched by native_decide. It has been something of a blocker for me on personal projects that formal conjectures is not on the module system.
yeah i added comments to the new sorry's

FC#4688 is now merged! I have one more quick PR FC#6138 (fixing a few more files and adding a CI check basically), but then this should finally be done for good.

Next I think it would be useful to think a little bit about imports; in particular if every conjecture file really needs to import all of FormalConjecturesForMathlib (and thus any public change in FormalConjecturesForMathlib needs very long rebuilds)

I heard that all conjecture files import everything for testing reasons (I presume so AlphaProof can utilize various theorems?). But for example, if FormalConjecturesUtil wouldnt import FormalConjecturesForMathlib(and instead only Mathlib) and each conjecture file the files from FormalConjecturesForMathlib it needs; this would basically not hide any useful information in each conjecture file, yet make rebuilds (after changing a small thing in ForMathlib) significantly faster.
Yes, this has been on my radar, but having a single import in every file is quite appealing
